snippet.title: CosmoKick.io  - Free to Play 3D Football Multiplayer Game Updated
snippet.description: The latest look at the progress of ComosKick.io. A free to play 3D football game, solo developed over the last 3 years. Almost ready for Beta Launch for the FIFA World CUP 🚀⚽️
